# Python tools for the SSTV interop tests. INSTALL WITH:
#
#     pip install --no-deps -r tests/scripts/requirements.txt
#
# `--no-deps` is required. The `sstv` decoder declares a dependency on the
# legacy `PySoundFile`, which ships no native libsndfile and collides with the
# modern `soundfile` module, making decoding fail. So we pin the full dependency
# set explicitly and skip transitive resolution: `PySoundFile` is never
# installed, and modern `soundfile` (which bundles libsndfile) provides the
# `soundfile` module.

# Encoder for the interop-decode test (tests/scripts/encode_with_pysstv.py).
pysstv

# Independent decoder for the encoder test (tests/scripts/decode_reference.py).
# Not on PyPI; installed from git.
sstv @ git+https://github.com/colaclanth/sstv

# Transitive dependencies, pinned explicitly because of --no-deps. `soundfile`
# stands in for the legacy PySoundFile that `sstv` would otherwise pull in.
pillow
numpy
scipy
cffi
pycparser
typing_extensions
soundfile
